name: print-social-purple-marketing-agency-speaker-post-with-script-accent
title: Purple marketing agency speaker post with script 'We Are Creative' and orange headline
whatItIs: A square post with a smiling man at a laptop, a purple gradient overlay rising from the left, a script 'We Are Creative' above bold orange 'MARKETING' and white 'AGENCY', guest speaker name and role, social icons and a phone number.
whatItMeans: Personable and professional; the script adds warmth to a corporate announcement.
techniques: Fade a brand colour over a photo to hold text.
Stack script, coloured caps and white caps as a headline trio.
Label the speaker with a coloured name and small role.

vocabulary.definition: A colour fade laid over a photo.
A handwritten-style line above the main headline.
